title: Adding a blocker does not cascade readiness to downstream dependents
description: Evidence: work block/dep add call runtime.addBlockingDependency, which writes only the directly blocked work item; downstream recompute helpers exist but are not called on this path. Impact: in A -> B -> C chains, adding a blocker to B can leave C stored as ready even though its dependency chain is blocked.
acceptanceCriteria: Dependency mutation propagates derived status to transitive dependents when a blocked item status changes.
Regression with A -> B -> C shows B and C both stored blocked and work list/sprint status agree.
